infra.trace.idPh: Paste a requestId, X-Amzn-Trace-Id, or your own correlation id…
infra.trace.kind.xray: X-Ray trace id — per-hop latency available
infra.trace.kind.request: request id — searched in log content
infra.trace.kind.free: correlation id — searched in log content
infra.trace.sourceNote.xray: Figures come from X-Ray: every hop carries its real processing time.
infra.trace.sourceNote.logs: Built from log lines that mention this id. The number between two hops is the GAP between them, not how long the hop took.
infra.trace.note.xrayFallback: This is an X-Ray trace id, but X-Ray could not return it (not enabled, no permission, or older than 30 days) — searched the log content instead.
infra.trace.noRows: This hop carries no log lines (it came from X-Ray).
infra.trace.truncated: Hit the row cap — hops may be missing. Narrow the time range and run again.
infra.trace.onGraphHint: Open the Graph tab and dim everything outside this request's path
infra.trace.emptyIdle: Paste a request id and hit Trace. AWOG searches the selected log groups for lines mentioning it, then lays them out on a timeline.
infra.trace.emptyNoGroup: No log groups selected. Pick the groups the request may pass through on the left (API Gateway, the Lambda functions, ECS services…).
infra.trace.emptyNoHop: No log line mentions this id. Try a wider time range, more log groups, or check the id.
infra.trace.error.TRACE_ID_TOO_LONG: That id is too long to be a request id.
infra.trace.error.INVALID_TRACE_ID: That id contains characters that are not allowed. A request id holds only letters, digits and . _ : @ = + -
infra.trace.error.NO_LOG_GROUP: No log group selected to search.
infra.trace.error.TOO_MANY_LOG_GROUPS: Too many log groups — 25 per run at most.
infra.trace.error.INVALID_WINDOW: That time range is not valid.
infra.trace.error.TIMEOUT: The query ran too long and we stopped waiting. Narrow the time range and try again.
infra.trace.error.Failed: AWS reported the query as failed.
infra.trace.error.Timeout: AWS cancelled the query for running past its limit.
infra.trace.error.Unknown: AWS returned a status we do not recognise.
